g.text: PortCloak — Ephemeral Clone Execution (never touch the serving instance)
1. Read the shape of the serving workload (read-only)
The serving instance is only ever READ.
PortCloak never execs into it, never writes
to its filesystem, never competes for its CPU.
Stripping app labels is critical: an inherited
Service load-balance real traffic into the
Cleanup runs on success AND failure.
next launch reap anything orphaned by a crash.
